product_one_liner.value: Fluxco helps transformer buyers, including data-center and renewable-energy project developers, turn equipment specifications into competitive bids from a global OEM marketplace and manage procurement through delivery and warranty.
product_one_liner.notes: Fluxco’s homepage describes its global transformer marketplace and specification submission process; the solution pages identify data-center and renewable-energy project buyers as intended users. The one-liner summarizes those product functions and audiences.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer lists navigation destinations but no pricing page. The FAQ discusses pricing factors and says options are quoted separately; it does not present public plans or prices. This supports no public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The closest located customer outcome names Antora Energy as one customer, but the cited customer report names fewer than two customers. Under the field rule, return an empty list rather than asserting an unsupported second name.

employee_band.notes: The Fluxco profile reports 13 employees, which falls in the 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile gives Fluxco’s primary location as Austin, Texas, US; the city is Austin. | hq_country: Fluxco’s LinkedIn company profile identifies its primary location as Austin, Texas, US, establishing the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The Fluxco company profile reports its founded year as 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The first-party Resources index presents buyers’ guides, transformer technical explainers and industry insights. These address transformer selection, specifications and market topics, not at least two engineer-authored posts about how Fluxco’s product is built, so it does not meet the engineering-blog criterion.

public_docs.notes: The homepage footer links to an FAQ but not product docs or a developer portal. The FAQ is a single general transformer FAQ page, while the Resources index is made up of buyer guides and transformer technical explainers rather than documentation for using the Fluxco product; the public-docs criterion is therefore not met.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers index lists an open Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native Generalist) position. AI appears in the title, matching the title-keyword rule, although the description focuses on general web and marketplace engineering rather than model research, so this classification is borderline.

compliance_certs.notes: Fluxco’s current legal/privacy policy describes the platform, its AI-assisted tools, service-provider categories and privacy practices, but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as a certification. The page is a first-party legal page; a separate trust page was not found, so this negative is somewhat qualified.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The profile labels the most recent round Seed. | funding_date: The funding profile dates the most recent Seed round to 27 July 2026, which is 2026-07 in YYYY-MM format. | funding_amount_usd: The Fluxco funding profile identifies a $26M Seed round; expressed in USD, the amount is 26,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The $26M Seed round was announced on 27 July 2026, within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Fluxco careers index lists open Enterprise Account Executive and Account Executive roles, meeting the specified sales-title criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: A dated company timeline reports the Global Transformer Network launch in August 2026, inside the six months before 2026-11-09. The source characterizes it as public positioning for end-to-end procurement, leasing and service, so treating it as a launch has some interpretation risk.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The LinkedIn profile identifies Brian Tochman as FluxCo Founder and CEO and dates the FluxCo experience start to 2026-01-01, within the 12 months before 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: An account-executive job post explicitly names LinkedIn as an outbound sales channel. No specific CRM vendor appears in the readable posting, so LinkedIn is the only identified sales/marketing platform signal. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting specifically names LinkedIn as a channel used for outbound sales prospecting.
